editorial:
You know those movies where a regular guy gets in way over his head? That is exactly what you get here. A night guard at an armored car company in the South gets pulled into one of the biggest bank heists in American history, and things spiral out of control fast. The cast is packed with funny people, and they bring a lot of energy to every scene. The Southern setting gives it a quirky charm, and the story moves quickly from one bad decision to the next. You will laugh at how clueless the main character can be while still rooting for him.

The acting is the real highlight, with strong comedic timing and some genuinely funny moments. The pacing keeps things moving, though a few jokes land better than others. Some scenes feel a bit silly, but that is part of the fun. If you enjoy goofy crime comedies with a true story twist, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the heist crew falls apart as greed and bad choices catch up with them. The main character finally realizes he has been used and tries to make things right. Law enforcement closes in, and the criminals turn on each other. The twist is that the mastermind behind the plan gets caught too, and the money does not bring anyone happiness. It ends with the main character facing the consequences of his actions.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy crime comedies and ensemble casts.
